user.title: APER HEMS — Installation
user.description: What kind of installation do you have?

equipment.title: APER HEMS — Equipment
equipment.description: Select the equipment you use. The integration will look for the right sensors automatically.

entities.title: APER HEMS — Detected sensors
entities.description: Check the sensors detected automatically. You can change them if needed.

data_description.grid_entity: Grid power — positive = import, negative = export (e.g. sensor.whatwatt_go_power_in)
data_description.production_entity: Power produced by your panels (e.g. sensor.fronius_power)
data_description.consumption_entity: Total power used by the house (optional, computed if missing)

api.title: APER HEMS — Connection
api.description: Enter the API key provided by APER (created from the aper-association.ch administration).

data_description.update_interval: Data sending interval in minutes (15 min recommended)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure APER HEMS
reconfigure.description: Change the settings of your integration. Advanced fields (meters, polarity) are optional.

data_description.grid_entity: Grid power — positive = import, negative = export
data_description.grid_import_positive: Uncheck if your grid sensor is inverted (positive = export)
data_description.battery_entity: Alternative to separate charge/discharge fields — single entity with a signed value (+ charge, - discharge)
data_description.battery_charge_positive: Uncheck if your battery sensor is inverted
data_description.meter_production: Cumulative kWh meter — takes priority over the power sensor if set
data_description.meter_import: Cumulative kWh grid import meter — takes priority over the grid sensor if set
data_description.meter_export: Cumulative kWh grid export meter — takes priority over the grid sensor if set
data_description.update_interval: Data sending interval in minutes (15 min recommended)

error.invalid_auth: API key rejected. Check it or ask APER for a new one.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach aper-association.ch. Try again in a moment.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured.

data_description.consumer_entity: Power sensor or energy meter of the consumer (e.g. EV charger, heat pump, pool…)
data_description.consumer_name: Name shown in the cockpit (100 characters at most)
